sentences.en: When you want cooperation, share the work among many hands.
sentences.zh: 当你想要合作时，就把工作分配给多双手。

sentences.en: That topic is too intimate to share with casual acquaintances.
sentences.zh: 那个话题太私密了，不适合与泛泛之交分享。

sentences.en: I will share the cost of the taxi with you.
sentences.zh: 我愿意和你分担出租车费。
